sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
♦ Wear the Black Tourmaline Crystal Pendant around your neck using the 24K gold tone plated chain provided with it.
♦ Set a clear intention before wearing it, especially for protection, grounding, emotional stability, and negativity removal.
♦ You can wear it during work, travel, meetings, meditation, or daily routine to keep its protective energy close.
♦ Clean the pendant and chain gently with a soft dry cloth whenever required.
♦ Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain its shine and finish.
♦ Store it safely in a dry place when not in use.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 🖤✨ Black Tourmaline Crystal Pendant with Chain
Symbol of Protection | Grounding Energy | Negativity Shield

Some crystals are not worn only for beauty — they are worn like a silent shield. The Black Tourmaline Crystal Pendant with Chain is one such powerful piece, designed for those who want to carry protection, grounding, and strength close to their heart every day.

Infused with Black Tourmaline Crystal, traditionally known as one of the most powerful protection crystals, this pendant is associated with energy protection, grounding, emotional stability, and shielding from negative energies.

Black Tourmaline is believed to help absorb unwanted energies, reduce negativity, and create a protective shield around the wearer. It is commonly used by people who want to feel more grounded, stable, and energetically secure in their daily life.

The pendant comes with an 24K gold tone plated chain, making it ready to wear from the moment you receive it. Its simple yet meaningful design makes it suitable for daily wear, work, travel, meditation, or as a protective crystal accessory.

This is a handcrafted crystal jewellery piece, crafted by India’s biggest crystal brand with attention to detail and quality. Each crystal passes through an authenticity check before it reaches you, ensuring a genuine and reliable crystal accessory.

Disclaimer: This product is designed as a symbolic and energetic aid and should be used alongside mindful decisions, consistent effort, and personal responsibility. It is not a substitute for your personal efforts.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What is included in this product?

This product includes a Black Tourmaline Crystal Pendant along with an 24K gold tone plated chain.

Q2. What is Black Tourmaline Crystal known for?

Black Tourmaline Crystal is traditionally known for protection, grounding, emotional stability, and shielding from negative energies.

Q3. Can I wear this pendant daily?

Yes, you can wear it daily as a protective crystal jewellery accessory, but keep it away from water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals.

Q4. Is the chain included with the pendant?

Yes, the pendant comes with an 24K gold tone plated chain, making it ready to wear.

Q5. Is this pendant handcrafted?

Yes, this is a handcrafted crystal jewellery piece, giving every pendant its own unique look and finish.

Q6. Will every crystal look the same?

No, every natural crystal is unique, so size, shape, texture, and colour may slightly vary.
